subject: Order Form: payment ladder, minimum commit & tax responsibility (CloudWave)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Order Form: payment ladder, minimum commit & tax responsibility (CloudWave)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attaching a draft Order Form (v2) and a simple payment ladder we discussed. Key items we want to confirm before legal review:

- Pricing schedule and tier breakpoints (Q1 usage ramp scenario included in the spreadsheet).
- Minimum commitment cadence: client prefers a staircase over 12 months; we proposed a 3-tranche ladder (25/35/40%). Need ops to confirm invoicing cadence.
- Net terms: CloudWave requested Net 45; standard Redwood is Net 30. Please confirm if Net 45 is tied to any discount.
- Taxes/withholding: CloudWave is in the US but with EMEA entities — they flagged potential VAT/responsibility for withholding. We need to decide whether tax gross-up language or responsibility clause goes in the Order Form or MSA appendix.

Next steps I propose:
1) You send procurement timeline (PO date and remittance entity).
2) If procurement signs off on Net 45, we can route to Kimberly for an MSA-level exception and redline the tax clause accordingly.
3) If you can provide the entity to invoice (US vs UK), we’ll map the invoice path.

Attaching: OrderForm_Draft_CW_v2.pdf, Payment_Ladder_Schedule_v1.xlsx

Open to a quick call if that helps — I have 11am PT on Thursday free.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudwave.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudwave.com>, James Li <james.li@cloudwave.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Order Form: payment ladder, minimum commit & tax responsibility (CloudWave)

Thanks Sean — quick responses inline below.

> Pricing schedule and tier breakpoints
We like the 3-tier approach, but procurement will ask to push the higher-volume tiers to month 6 instead of month 9 so our finance team can forecast. Can you update the spreadsheet to show an alternative ramp (50% of expected usage by month 6)?

> Minimum commitment cadence
We can accept a staged minimum commit but need the invoicing to follow monthly usage with quarterly reconciliation.

> Net terms (Net 45)
We prefer Net 45. This is non-negotiable for this workload unless Redwood can provide a 3% settlement discount for Net 30. Please advise if Redwood has a standard discount for shorter payment windows.

> Taxes/withholding
CloudWave will likely invoice through our UK subsidiary for some services (CloudWave UK Ltd). Our tax team requests that Redwood accepts responsibility for any gross-up only where Redwood invoices the UK entity directly; otherwise CloudWave will withhold and remit.

Procurement timeline: we expect to have a PO issued by Dec 10 if legal turnaround is within one week after your redline.

Aisha
Director, Procurement | CloudWave
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Order Form: payment ladder, minimum commit & tax responsibility (CloudWave) — legal review request

Kimberly / Ben — forwarding CloudWave’s feedback. Can you: 

1) Review the attached OrderForm_Draft_CW_v2.pdf and Payment_Ladder_Schedule_v1.xlsx (attached again).
2) Suggest redline language for: (a) tax/gross-up vs withholding allocation, (b) Net 45 exception and whether we should attach a settlement discount table, (c) invoicing entity clause and monthly invoicing with quarterly reconciliation.
3) Confirm whether we can accept the requested month-6 ramp alternative or if that materially changes pricing tiers (Ben).

Important context: CloudWave will sign quickly if we accept Net 45 without material concessions on pricing. If we need to push Net 30, we may need to offer a 2-3% early payment discount to preserve economics.

Attached: OrderForm_Draft_CW_v2.pdf; Payment_Ladder_Schedule_v1.xlsx

Thanks — can we get comments by end of day Friday (Dec 4)? Procurement wants PO by Dec 10.

—Sean
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Order Form: payment ladder, minimum commit & tax responsibility (CloudWave) — redline summary attached

Sean / Ben — thanks, reviewed and attached a short redline summary (redline-summary-kp-20261204.docx). High-level recommendations below: 

1) Taxes/Withholding — proposed MSA appendix language:
   - Redwood to invoice the entity designated by CloudWave. If CloudWave’s designated entity is outside the US and withholds taxes, CloudWave will notify Redwood in advance. Redwood will accept gross-up only where Redwood chooses to invoice the non-US entity directly (explicitly stated on the Order Form). For other cases, CloudWave shall withhold as required by local law; parties will cooperate in good faith to provide documentation.

2) Net Terms exception — commercial options:
   - Option A (preferred): Accept Net 45 for this order provided CloudWave executes the attached settlement schedule (Annex A) with no changes. No discount.
   - Option B: Default Net 30; offer 2% settlement discount if CloudWave pays within 15 days (applies to pre-paid tranche only).
   
3) Invoicing cadence & reconciliation — draft language:
   - Monthly invoices issued to the invoicing entity specified on the Order Form. Quarterly reconciliation to true up usage against the minimum commit. Any shortfall will be invoiced at the agreed unit price; overages billed at the applicable tier rate.

4) Pricing ramp compromise — Ben: suggest we accept the month-6 ramp but tie tier breakpoints to cumulative usage; the price for tier 2 will only apply once cumulative usage exceeds the threshold for month 6 (this protects Redwood from early over-discounting).

5) Attachments / Execution path:
   - I uploaded a DocuSign envelope (link below) with the MSA appendix and Order Form placeholders. Recommend sending to CloudWave procurement after you confirm Net terms approach.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/send/abc123-CW-OF
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/CR-8472

If you want me to push the Net 45 approval upstairs, provide the commercial rationale (ARR impact / expected payment speed) and I’ll escalate. Otherwise Option A is the cleanest commercial commit.

Kimberly
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
